description: This PHP script is a test tool for cleaning up a specific plugins directory in the OrangeHRM system. It checks if the environment is production mode and, if not, deletes a plugin directory related to functional testing.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A configuration class that provides environment mode constants and plugin directory paths.

methods.name: Config::get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values based on the provided key.

methods.name: Config::MODE_PROD
methods.description: Constant representing the production environment mode value.

methods.name: Filesystem::remove
methods.description: Removes files or directories specified in the array.
